question: Can a causally pre-available ordinary-noise reference built only from disjoint metadata-matched donor cases approximate each target case's own first-ready eight-frame ordinary-noise reference better than a preregistered cross-noise-domain negative-control donor, especially for target cases that exhibit pre-ready speech?

reference_semantics.donor_case_summary: median mirror_mean, mirror_concentration and mirror_gap over the first eight ordinary-noise non-disagreement frames after warmup
reference_semantics.target_benchmark: the target case's own first-ready snapshot: medians over its first eight ordinary-noise non-disagreement frames after warmup
reference_semantics.target_benchmark_role: retrospective agreement benchmark only; never a causal input for earlier target frames
reference_semantics.donor_aggregate: component-wise median across the selected K donor-case first-ready summaries

matched_donor_selection.ordering: lexicographically minimize [scenario_group_mismatch, reverb_mismatch, snr_missing_penalty, absolute_snr_distance, exact_scenario_mismatch, case_key]

negative_control.purpose: preregistered cross-noise-domain control using the identical metadata-compatibility ordering

populations.evaluation_scope: all metadata-defined noise-domain target cases; clean-only cases are outside donor-domain feasibility scope
populations.primary_directional_population: target cases with at least one pre-ready oracle-speech disagreement target under the unchanged eight-reference observation boundary

directional_hypothesis.primary_population: target cases with at least one pre-ready speech target
directional_hypothesis.comparison: absolute error of matched donor reference versus absolute error of fixed cross-domain negative-control reference against target first-ready benchmark
support_requires: median paired improvement (negative error - matched error) > 0

diagnostic_outputs: per-target selected matched and negative donor case identities
matched and negative absolute errors for mean, concentration and gap
paired median error improvement and matched-better fractions
one-sided paired sign test for the preregistered primary gap metric

decision_contract.NS_UPSTREAM_INDEPENDENT_DONOR_REFERENCE_: Fresh donor/target authority, disjoint identity, frozen metadata-only donor selection, benchmark/coverage gates and exact mirrors are valid. Report matched-versus-negative donor agreement and the preregistered directional hypothesis for review without selecting a reference source or running component counterfactuals.
decision_contract.I029_INPUT_INVALID_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Dataset identity, frozen-input identity, donor/target disjointness, donor/benchmark coverage, per-domain donor availability, paired-population coverage, shipping mirror or authority preconditions fail.

next_review: Use I029 only to judge whether metadata-matched independent donor references have measurable agreement advantage over the fixed cross-domain control on the pre-ready-speech population. Any reference-source candidate, donor persistence mechanism, component counterfactual, mapping or shipping change requires a new independently preregistered authority.
